body:
Great, thanks so much, Gina!  Will push out an update with the last (?) tweaks shortly.
I have a couple of questions/comments on your edits.

> TestOfTwitterCrawler: Removed explicit table truncation, FixtureBuilder::destroy does that for us

I was wondering about this.  The reason I added it was that the favorites content is not built explicitly via the FixtureBuilder, but was added via the crawler method.  So I wasn't sure whether it would get cleaned out between tests.

> TwitterCrawler: Removed try/catch, the APIAccessor object should handle any parsing exceptions

I am wondering if perhaps all public crawler methods (called from TwitterPlugin) should have try/catch clauses wrapping their activity, and return a status. That way if something unexpected goes wrong with one piece, the rest of the crawler run can continue. (we've obviated the need to deal with API-related errors, but there could be other issues).
